name: Tufted puffin
desc: A diving seabird that nests in burrows on cliffs and islands. Adults eat squid and krill, and chicks are fed mostly fish such as sand lance.
about: The tufted puffin, also known as crested puffin, is a relatively abundant medium-sized pelagic seabird in the auk family (Alcidae) found throughout the North Pacific Ocean.
